title: aMQTT: Denial of Service (DoS) via Memory Leak in Unmanaged QoS 2 Session Handshakes (CVE-2026-130176)
description: The amqtt package versions 0.11.0 through 0.12.0 contain a denial-of-service vulnerability due to a memory leak in the handling of incomplete MQTT QoS 2 transactions. When clients initiate QoS 2 handshakes but disconnect before completion, the broker retains transaction state indefinitely, causing unbounded memory growth. This can lead to broker process termination and loss of availability. The issue is patched in version 0.12.1.
